rationale: The majority is likely to write narrowly around United States v. $8,850 and Von Neumann, holding due process does not categorically require a separate prompt post-seizure retention hearing so long as the forfeiture proceeding is pursued with reasonable promptness and offers meaningful tools/remedies for delay. Dissents will press a Mathews-based “interim retention” theory emphasizing severe hardship and coercive leverage from months-long vehicle deprivation, especially for innocent owners.
